Signup path: self-serve, used quickstart, got hosted API key automatically.

Competitive pressure: currently evaluating OpenAI due to initial free credits — 'we can get started for free there', VP said.

Quote from demo: 'Works well for short answers — but we need it to be predictable cost-wise.'
Tactics tried: sent simplified cost examples, 'cost per 1k tokens' table, and short integration checklist.
Main risk: trial stalls after first key; likely to lapse unless nudged with usage example + promo credit.

use_case_summary: Small support-SaaS wants hosted API for in-app support chat and KB search. Early self-serve signup but nearly inactive after provisioning key. Cost predictability = highest priority; no heavy compliance needs today.
sales_play_notes: SMB inbound -> quick win play. Offer starter credit + prepaid monthly cap. Emphasize low-latency hosted endpoints and simple billing portal. If they prefer competitor credits, counter with low-cost per-token examples and caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
